title: Out-of-training properties in frozen interatomic potential embeddings are decodable and ordered by physical scale
abstract: arXiv:2611.21116v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are trained on energies, forces and stresses, yet their frozen representations can predict other materials properties. We probe ORB-v3 and UMA-S across layers, read-outs and equivariant channels for nine properties of 154,875 Materials Project crystals. Both models outperform composition-only descriptors on all targets, including five outside their training objectives; errors in physical units help assess potential screening applications. Optimal depth varies by property, consistent with a physical-scale ordering. Random-weight controls reveal strongly property-dependent benefits of pretraining. UMA-S's rotation-invariant angular channels improve crystal-system classification, while higher scores from its full tensor disappear under rotation; matched-model controls do not isolate equivariance as the explanation. translated_title: 冻结原子间势嵌入中的训练外性质可被解码并按物理尺度排序
translated_abstract: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）通常在能量、力和应力上进行训练，但其冻结的表征却能够预测其他材料性质。我们在154,875个Materials Project晶体上，跨越不同层、读取方式和等变通道，探测了ORB-v3和UMA-S两种模型对九种性质的预测能力。两个模型在所有目标上都优于仅基于化学成分的描述符，其中包括五种超出其训练目标的性质；以物理单位表示的误差有助于评估其在潜在高通量筛选应用中的价值。最优解码深度随性质不同而变化，这与物理尺度的排序规律一致。随机权重对照实验揭示了预训练带来的收益强烈依赖于具体性质。UMA-S的旋转不变角通道改善了晶系分类性能，而其完整张量所获得的更高分数在旋转下消失；匹配模型的对照实验未能将等变性单独确认为解释原因。不同探测方法之间的准确度有所差异，但最近邻预测通常……
tldr: 机器学习原子间势的冻结嵌入不仅能够解码出训练目标之外的材料性质，其最优解码深度还呈现出随物理尺度有序排列的规律。
en_tdlr: Frozen embeddings of machine-learned interatomic potentials can decode material properties beyond their training objectives, with optimal decoding depth ordered by physical scale.
